verdict.rationale: SendGrid's Inbound Parse webhook lets developers configure a hostname to POST parsed inbound email data to a URL of their choice, which supports basic endpoint-based routing, but there's no evidence of rule-based matching on recipient patterns, or built-in forward/store actions — only the parse-and-POST mechanism is documented. missing for 10: recipient-pattern matching rules, multiple destination routing logic, forward-to-mailbox option, store-without-forwarding option, independent confirmation of complex routing setups.
